$comment: SAMPLE. To use it: copy to the app root as mcp.adapter.json, import it from
src/agent/contract/manifest.ts, and send it to the host with
- version must be 1; id, name, server.url required.
- server.url is MCP Connector's gateway on loopback: http://127.0.0.1:3920/mcp
(transport streamable-http | sse). The host refuses non-loopback URLs.
- requires: capability names the app needs. proposals: servers the connector
shows the user in full; nothing runs until the user saves it.
This sample proposes the connector's builtin fetch (spec.kind adapter, builtins [fetch]).
spec.kind: stdio | http | adapter | script. The legacy 'connector' field is rejected.
- discovery: live = use the gateway's tools/list when it returns tools (catalog entries overlay promptHint/humanApproval by name); catalog = only catalog.tools.
- namespace prefixes tool names for the agent: fetch -> local.fetch.
- Agents reach these tools when capabilities.attachedMcp is 'all' or a list of names.
name: Local tools

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: HTTP request from this computer (MCP Connector builtin). http and https only.

humanApproval.title: Fetch from this computer
humanApproval.message: Let the agent make an HTTP request from your machine.
